title: Consolidate sparse metric footprint and reduce dashboard noise after capacity outage
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Summary: During the 2026-03-09 console capacity event we discovered multiple blind spots that slowed detection and diagnosis: a sparse metric footprint for tenant-level ingress (no percentiles, only averages), high-cardinality dashboard panels that lost aggregates under load, and several trace paths where tenant labels and request lifecycle spans were not propagated (orphan spans). These combined to hide tail latency and queue backpressure until customer-facing errors rose. This ticket consolidates an actionable plan to expand critical telemetry, reduce dashboard noise, and ensure trace continuity for fast incident triage.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant-level ingress queue depth metric emitted at 1s granularity and visible as aggregate and per-tenant percentiles in Console dashboards
Top-10 Console dashboards simplified: remove noisy high-cardinality panels or add pre-aggregations; panels render under 2s at 95th percentile during synthetic load
Tracing: ensure tenant_id and request_lifecycle span are propagated through edge -> router -> runtime components for 99% of sampled traces
Runbook updated with new dashboard locations, playbook to surface tail-latency alerts, and on-call checklist for metric/trace blind spots
action_items: ENG: Add meter 'console.ingress.queue_depth' with tags {tenant_id, route} and percentile aggregation pipeline (owner: Diego Martín, due: 2026-03-17)
ENG: Implement lightweight pre-aggregation job for high-cardinality panels to feed dashboards with rollups (owner: Priya Desai, due: 2026-03-24)
ENG: Patch trace instrumentation to propagate tenant_id and request_lifecycle span context through edge proxies and runtime schedulers (owner: Linh Tran, due: 2026-03-21)
PM: Prioritize three dashboard views for simplification and add 'signal-to-noise' metric to evaluate panel usefulness (owner: Marco Alvarez, due: 2026-03-18)
SRE: Create alert 'console.tail_latency_unseen' triggered by divergence between mean and p95/p99 metrics indicating aggregation loss (owner: SRE Team, due: 2026-03-20)
Docs: Update incident runbook and on-call checklist with steps to detect missing aggregates and fallback queries (owner: Aisha Khan, due: 2026-03-19)
updates: 2026-03-10: Ticket created after postmortem readout. Priority set to P1 due to customer impact; initial owners assigned.
2026-03-11: Spike completed — discovered that existing 'queue_size' metric is emitted only as a cluster average; proof-of-concept patch adds tenant_id tag without noticeable CPU overhead (Linh).

2026-03-12: Design review with PM and SRE — agreed to prefer percentile aggregates over raw p95 in dashboards and to add pre-aggregation to avoid high-cardinality rendering costs. Decision: add rollup every 30s and 5m for dashboard feeds.
2026-03-13: SRE requested an additional synthetic load test to validate dashboard rendering time; scheduled for 2026-03-16. Diego started implementation of ingress queue metric.
2026-03-14: Runtime patch for trace propagation landed in feature branch; integration test failing in one proxy variant — Linh assigned to root-cause and patch.
